findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Observed a leak to be present under triple sink. Discussed with PIC, sink will be serviced. Ensure no leaks are present within facility, inspector will follow-up with facility on 9/29/26.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be present upon arrival. Discussed with PIC, CFM arrrived during inspection. Ensure a certified food manager is available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed black mold to be present at the bar soda gun. Discussed with PIC, soda gun was cleaned and sanitized. Ensure equipment food contact surfaces are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents any black mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed rice to be hot holding at 125F. Discussed with PIC, rice was reheated to 165F, placed in a smaller container, and returned to steam table. Ensure any TCS item being hot holding is kept at or above 135F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(1) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained: (1) At 57°C (135°F) or above, except that roasts cooked to a temperature and for a time specified in 3-401.11(B) or reheated as specified in 3-403.11(E) may be held at a temperature of 54°C (130°F) or above.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple TCS item kept in coolers to be kept past its 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, education was provided on proper date marking and items were discarded. Ensure any item kept longer than its 7 day date marking maximum is discarded.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed a significant amount of flies to be present within facility. Discussed with PIC, facility will contact Orkin to service facility. Ensure no pests are present within facility, inspector will follow up on 9/24/26.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111(C) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (C) Using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed clean knives to be soiled with food debris. Discussed with PIC, knives were put through wash, rinse, and sanitize process. Ensure when cleaned, utensils are stored in a way that prevents any contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-904.11(A) Kitchenware and Tableware. (A) SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of FOOD and lip-contact surfaces is prevented.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed a floor vent to have an accumulation of dust. Discussed with PIC, vent will be replaced. Ensure vents are being cleaned at a frequency that prevents dust accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed multiple pieces of fruit to be resting in bar ice machine. Discussed with PIC, fruit items were removed from ice. Ensure ice is being protected from any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.comment: Observed ice scoop handle to be in contact with ice at bar ice machine. Discussed with PIC, ice scoop was moved so handle is outside of ice. Ensure ice scoop handle is kept out of contact with ice to prevent any possible contamination.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed dish machine to be testing a 0ppm CL. Discussed with PIC, dish machine will be serviced. Inspecotr instructed facility to use triple sink for all dish washing until dish machine is serviced.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored.
findings.comment: Observed bar ice scoop to be resting in contact with ice. Discussed with PIC, ice scoop was removed from ice and placed in a sanitized location. Ensure ice scoop is kept out of contact with ice to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-304.12(A) In-Use Utensils, Between-Use Storage. During pauses in FOOD preparation or dispensing, FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) Except as specified under (B) of this section, in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple TCS foods to not have date marking sticker present. Discussed with PIC, stickers were placed on TCS foods. Ensure any TCS food kept longer than 24 hours is properly date marked.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.17(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Date Marking. (A) Except when PACKAGING FOOD using a REDUCED OXYGEN PACKAGING method as specified under § 3-502.12, and except as specified in (E) and (F) of this section, refrigerated, READY-TO-EAT, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD prepared and held in a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date or day by which the FOOD shall be consumed on the PREMISES, sold, or discarded when held at a temperature of 5C (41F) or less for a maximum of 7 days. The day of preparation shall be counted as Day 1.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed multiple TCS foods to be kept past their 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, items were discarded.  Ensure all TCS foods are being date marked and are being discarded after their 7 day date marking maximum.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment: Observed cleaned utensils to be stored with handle facing down. Discussed with PIC, utensils will be inverted. Ensure utensils are stored inverted, with the handle facing up to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(B) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (B) Clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS shall be stored as specified under (A) of this section and shall be stored: (1) In a self-draining position that allows air drying; and (2) Covered or inverted.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Observed 2 personal items being stored within a box of dried peppers in the dry storage area. Discussed with PIC, personal items were relocated. Ensure personal items are stored in a way that prevents any potential contamination. 

6-403.11: (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES cannot occur.
